targets.measured: of the creatures a daily player has owned for two weeks or more, 100% are within 5 levels of their 3rd best at week 4 (worst 4 levels below the 3rd best, median 2, worst without those held at the evolution level 2) and 73% at week 8 (worst 10 levels below the 3rd best, median 3, worst without those held at the evolution level 6); the 6th creature (a second team's best) is 2 below the 3rd at week 8. An optimiser's share at week 4 is 100% (pass). It also depends on how fast creatures arrive: at the docs' 2% an hour (the default here is 1.3%) a set-and-forget player's share at week 4 is 100% (pass) and an optimiser's 100% (pass)
targets.target: creatures owned two weeks or more within 5 levels of the 3rd best at weeks 4 and 8, and two strong teams at week 8

targets.measured: an optimiser visiting three times a day gets 103% of an optimiser visiting once in XP and 100% in posts' and the allowance's output over 24 weeks. In the model extra visits add no rate (idle gains run at the same rate however often a player looks in), so this passes by construction: it shows only that nothing in the rules pays a frequent visitor more, not that choices are worth little
a weekend-off player gets 98% of a daily player's idle growth (effective hours, weeks 1 to 12)
targets.target: about 100% (a weekend off costs almost nothing)
